title: GTA 6 Easter Eggs & Hidden Details You Probably Missed
title_alternatives: 20 GTA 6 Secrets Rockstar Hid in Plain Sight
GTA 6 Easter Eggs: Vice City, RDR2 and Tommy Vercetti References
description_summary: The best GTA 6 easter eggs and hidden details so far: the literal easter egg on a tower, Tommy Vercetti and Vice City callbacks, Liberty City links, Red Dead references, radio returns, and the small details that make Leonida feel alive. Confirmed facts and fan theories are labelled.

beats.caption: Rockstar hides things in every GTA, and GTA 6 is already full of them. Callbacks to Vice City, links to Liberty City and Red Dead, and one easter egg that is, quite literally, an egg.
beats.tts: Rockstar hides things in every GTA, and GTA 6 is already full of them. Callbacks to Vice City, links to Liberty City and Red Dead, and one easter egg that is, quite literally, an egg.
beats.visual_need: Vice City at sunset, slow pan

beats.caption: I'll be clear about what's confirmed and what's a fan theory, because a lot of what's going around online is guesswork. Let's start with the one everyone's talking about.
beats.tts: I'll be clear about what's confirmed and what's a fan theory, because a lot of what's going around online is guesswork. Let's start with the one everyone's talking about.

beats.caption: Players found a bird's nest full of colourful eggs at the top of a tower in Leonida, reportedly a radio or communications tower. The climb takes about seven minutes.
beats.tts: Players found a bird's nest full of colourful eggs at the top of a tower in Leonida, reportedly a radio or communications tower. The climb takes about seven minutes.

beats.caption: Take one of the eggs and throw it toward the ground, and a short cutscene plays showing the egg smashing onto the windscreen of a car driving below.
beats.tts: Take one of the eggs and throw it toward the ground, and a short cutscene plays showing the egg smashing onto the windscreen of a car driving below.

beats.caption: The footage was shared on X by a player called xGarbett on November 18th, right after the game's staggered release. You can even talk to an influencer at the top of the tower. The exact tower isn't confirmed in Rockstar's materials, so treat the location as player-reported.
beats.tts: The footage was shared on X by a player called xGarbett on November 18th, right after the game's staggered release. You can even talk to an influencer at the top of the tower. The exact tower isn't confirmed in Rockstar's materials, so treat the location as player-reported.

beats.caption: It's a nod to a classic: the original Vice City had a hidden room with an actual chocolate easter egg inside. Rockstar has been doing this for over twenty years.
beats.tts: It's a nod to a classic: the original Vice City had a hidden room with an actual chocolate easter egg inside. Rockstar has been doing this for over twenty years.

beats.caption: Tommy Vercetti isn't in GTA 6, but his name is. Two revolvers in the Ultimate Edition, the Hawk and the Little Morgan, are listed as sourced from the Vercetti Estate, with palm-tree engravings on the grips.
beats.tts: Tommy Vercetti isn't in GTA 6, but his name is. Two revolvers in the Ultimate Edition, the Hawk and the Little Morgan, are listed as sourced from the Vercetti Estate, with palm-tree engravings on the grips.

beats.caption: And promo material shows Jason and Lucia outside the Ocean View Hotel, which was Tommy's very first safehouse in the 2002 game. That one is a deliberate callback.
beats.tts: And promo material shows Jason and Lucia outside the Ocean View Hotel, which was Tommy's very first safehouse in the 2002 game. That one is a deliberate callback.

beats.caption: Fan theory territory: in the second trailer, a painting of an iguana appears to be wearing Tommy's famous tropical shirt. Fans spotted it, but Rockstar hasn't confirmed it.
beats.tts: Fan theory territory: in the second trailer, a painting of an iguana appears to be wearing Tommy's famous tropical shirt. Fans spotted it, but Rockstar hasn't confirmed it.

beats.caption: Why does this matter? Because it confirms that Vice City's history still exists in this universe. Tommy built an empire here, and decades later his estate is selling off guns. That's a great bit of world-building for anyone who played the original.
beats.tts: Why does this matter? Because it confirms that Vice City's history still exists in this universe. Tommy built an empire here, and decades later his estate is selling off guns. That's a great bit of world-building for anyone who played the original.

beats.caption: Flash FM is back. It was a radio station in the original Vice City, and Rockstar has confirmed its return.
beats.tts: Flash FM is back. It was a radio station in the original Vice City, and Rockstar has confirmed its return.

beats.caption: Slayer's Raining Blood is back too. It played on V-Rock in the original Vice City, and in GTA 6 it shows up on The Chamber 106.6, a station hosted by Slayer members as DJ Tom and DJ Kerry.
beats.tts: Slayer's Raining Blood is back too. It played on V-Rock in the original Vice City, and in GTA 6 it shows up on The Chamber 106.6, a station hosted by Slayer members as DJ Tom and DJ Kerry.

beats.caption: And Phil Collins' Against All Odds appears in the extended promo footage. Collins was in Vice City Stories, where he played a virtual concert at Hyman Memorial Stadium.
beats.tts: And Phil Collins' Against All Odds appears in the extended promo footage. Collins was in Vice City Stories, where he played a virtual concert at Hyman Memorial Stadium.

beats.caption: In the second trailer, a man fires a weapon under a sign that reads Phil's Ammu-Nation. Some fans think it's Phil Cassidy from Vice City, or a relative. Again, Rockstar hasn't confirmed it, so file this under theory.
beats.tts: In the second trailer, a man fires a weapon under a sign that reads Phil's Ammu-Nation. Some fans think it's Phil Cassidy from Vice City, or a relative. Again, Rockstar hasn't confirmed it, so file this under theory.

beats.caption: If you never played the original: Phil Cassidy was Vice City's one-armed arms dealer, who ran his own gun range out in the country. A Phil's Ammu-Nation is exactly the kind of joke Rockstar loves, which is why fans want this one to be real.
beats.tts: If you never played the original: Phil Cassidy was Vice City's one-armed arms dealer, who ran his own gun range out in the country. A Phil's Ammu-Nation is exactly the kind of joke Rockstar loves, which is why fans want this one to be real.

beats.caption: Here's a confirmed one from the official character profiles. Lucia's mother wanted a good life for her ever since their days in Liberty City, the setting of GTA 3 and GTA 4.
beats.tts: Here's a confirmed one from the official character profiles. Lucia's mother wanted a good life for her ever since their days in Liberty City, the setting of GTA 3 and GTA 4.

beats.caption: And players have found books in the game that mention Red Dead Redemption and GTA 4. Rockstar keeps hinting that its worlds are connected.
beats.tts: And players have found books in the game that mention Red Dead Redemption and GTA 4. Rockstar keeps hinting that its worlds are connected.

beats.caption: Another Red Dead link, this one a theory: during a TV scene with Jason, there's footage of animals grazing by a river just before a Prairie Sandwich Meal ad. Reddit users think that landscape comes from Red Dead Redemption 2.
beats.tts: Another Red Dead link, this one a theory: during a TV scene with Jason, there's footage of animals grazing by a river just before a Prairie Sandwich Meal ad. Reddit users think that landscape comes from Red Dead Redemption 2.
beats.visual_need: TV screen in a living room

beats.caption: And a sticker in the first trailer appears to show Everett Morgan, a Red Dead Online character. Also unconfirmed, but it fits the pattern.
beats.tts: And a sticker in the first trailer appears to show Everett Morgan, a Red Dead Online character. Also unconfirmed, but it fits the pattern.

beats.caption: Going back even further, the launch trailer shows North Fort Law. Longtime fans will recognise it as the military base from the very first GTA, in the State of New Guernsey.
beats.tts: Going back even further, the launch trailer shows North Fort Law. Longtime fans will recognise it as the military base from the very first GTA, in the State of New Guernsey.

beats.caption: The trailer also leaves an open question there: we don't know if that's a flashback to Jason's army days or a present-day mission where he calls in old squadmates. TechWiser flagged it, and nobody can say for sure yet.
beats.tts: The trailer also leaves an open question there: we don't know if that's a flashback to Jason's army days or a present-day mission where he calls in old squadmates. TechWiser flagged it, and nobody can say for sure yet.

beats.caption: The classic brands are back. Weazel News appears to report on a police chase in the first trailer. Sessanta Nove, the fake luxury fashion label from GTA 5, returns too.
beats.tts: The classic brands are back. Weazel News appears to report on a police chase in the first trailer. Sessanta Nove, the fake luxury fashion label from GTA 5, returns too.

beats.caption: And here's one that escaped the game entirely: fans spotted real-life Weazel News ads in Miami. Rockstar's fake news network showed up in the real city that inspired Vice City.
beats.tts: And here's one that escaped the game entirely: fans spotted real-life Weazel News ads in Miami. Rockstar's fake news network showed up in the real city that inspired Vice City.

beats.caption: In extended footage, there's a Fleeca Bank sticker on Jason's fridge. And the launch trailer has a fried chicken bucket parody that fans linked to a well-known fast food chain.
beats.tts: In extended footage, there's a Fleeca Bank sticker on Jason's fridge. And the launch trailer has a fried chicken bucket parody that fans linked to a well-known fast food chain.

beats.caption: Fleeca, if you don't remember, was the bank chain from GTA 5, the one behind the Fleeca Job heist. Seeing it on Jason's fridge is a quiet way of saying Los Santos and Leonida share the same world.
beats.tts: Fleeca, if you don't remember, was the bank chain from GTA 5, the one behind the Fleeca Job heist. Seeing it on Jason's fridge is a quiet way of saying Los Santos and Leonida share the same world.

beats.caption: And the '95 Grotti Cheetah is a modern take on the classic Cheetah sports car, with a retro-futuristic livery. It's one of the Ultimate Edition cars.
beats.tts: And the '95 Grotti Cheetah is a modern take on the classic Cheetah sports car, with a retro-futuristic livery. It's one of the Ultimate Edition cars.

beats.caption: Car fans also spotted a supercar in the launch trailer with a Ferrari SF90-style shape. Rockstar always parodies real cars, and GTA 6 has some of its closest lookalikes yet.
beats.tts: Car fans also spotted a supercar in the launch trailer with a Ferrari SF90-style shape. Rockstar always parodies real cars, and GTA 6 has some of its closest lookalikes yet.

beats.caption: And honestly, the parodies are half the fun. Rockstar's sense of humour is sharpest when it's poking at real brands, and Leonida is clearly packed with them.
beats.tts: And honestly, the parodies are half the fun. Rockstar's sense of humour is sharpest when it's poking at real brands, and Leonida is clearly packed with them.

beats.caption: Now the small stuff that makes Leonida feel alive. Weapons stay visible on your character even when you're sitting in a car as a passenger.
beats.tts: Now the small stuff that makes Leonida feel alive. Weapons stay visible on your character even when you're sitting in a car as a passenger.

beats.caption: Firearms have serial numbers, and some of them reference previous GTA games. Rockstar hid easter eggs inside the guns themselves.
beats.tts: Firearms have serial numbers, and some of them reference previous GTA games. Rockstar hid easter eggs inside the guns themselves.

beats.caption: The launch trailer also shows rideable electric scooters, multiple jet skis, and what looks like a returning blimp. Fans are hoping that blimp is flyable again.
beats.tts: The launch trailer also shows rideable electric scooters, multiple jet skis, and what looks like a returning blimp. Fans are hoping that blimp is flyable again.
beats.visual_need: jet skis on water, blimp in sky

beats.caption: TechWiser spotted a Komodo dragon hiding in a swamp scene in the trailer, and a Marauder print on a shirt that matches an arm tattoo, possibly a hint at Jason's army past.
beats.tts: TechWiser spotted a Komodo dragon hiding in a swamp scene in the trailer, and a Marauder print on a shirt that matches an arm tattoo, possibly a hint at Jason's army past.

beats.caption: And the six-star wanted level is back for the first time since GTA 4. GTA 5 capped it at five.
beats.tts: And the six-star wanted level is back for the first time since GTA 4. GTA 5 capped it at five.

beats.caption: Six stars was last seen in GTA 4 and Chinatown Wars, so bringing it back is a callback in itself, and a warning about how serious the police are this time.
beats.tts: Six stars was last seen in GTA 4 and Chinatown Wars, so bringing it back is a callback in itself, and a warning about how serious the police are this time.

beats.caption: Even the wildlife has secrets. The in-game wildlife chart lists alligators, boars, bobcats, snakes and more, and it has a separate symbol for toxic waste. Somewhere in Leonida, something is glowing.
beats.tts: Even the wildlife has secrets. The in-game wildlife chart lists alligators, boars, bobcats, snakes and more, and it has a separate symbol for toxic waste. Somewhere in Leonida, something is glowing.

beats.caption: Flamingos and alligators share the Grassrivers, and the underwater areas hold treasure and secrets of their own. If a place looks empty, it usually isn't.
beats.tts: Flamingos and alligators share the Grassrivers, and the underwater areas hold treasure and secrets of their own. If a place looks empty, it usually isn't.

beats.caption: There are secrets in Jason's own house, too. Under the loose floorboards in his bedroom, where you can stash cash, you'll find old photos that add to his backstory.
beats.tts: There are secrets in Jason's own house, too. Under the loose floorboards in his bedroom, where you can stash cash, you'll find old photos that add to his backstory.

beats.caption: And meet Dolores, Jason's pet snake. Feed her and you get a small early Focus boost. It's a tiny detail, but it tells you how much Rockstar wanted this world to feel lived in.
beats.tts: And meet Dolores, Jason's pet snake. Feed her and you get a small early Focus boost. It's a tiny detail, but it tells you how much Rockstar wanted this world to feel lived in.

beats.caption: Gloriana is another fun one. People speculated it was a whole new state, but it appears to be just a single key island.
beats.tts: Gloriana is another fun one. People speculated it was a whole new state, but it appears to be just a single key island.

beats.caption: Want to find your own? Use Focus Mode. It highlights interactables in yellow, so hidden notes and objects stand out.
beats.tts: Want to find your own? Use Focus Mode. It highlights interactables in yellow, so hidden notes and objects stand out.

beats.caption: Check the minimap inside shops for back rooms and staircases, and look for dark blue buildings on the map, because those have interiors. Most secrets are inside, not on the street.
beats.tts: Check the minimap inside shops for back rooms and staircases, and look for dark blue buildings on the map, because those have interiors. Most secrets are inside, not on the street.

beats.caption: And climb things. The egg was at the top of a seven-minute climb. If Rockstar put a long climb somewhere, there's usually a reason.
beats.tts: And climb things. The egg was at the top of a seven-minute climb. If Rockstar put a long climb somewhere, there's usually a reason.

beats.caption: And remember the scale here: more than seven hundred enterable interiors have been reported. Rockstar hid that egg in one tower. Imagine what's sitting in the rest.
beats.tts: And remember the scale here: more than seven hundred enterable interiors have been reported. Rockstar hid that egg in one tower. Imagine what's sitting in the rest.

beats.caption: The fun part is that the community is still early. The game only came out days ago, so the biggest secrets almost certainly haven't been found yet. Expect a part two.
beats.tts: The fun part is that the community is still early. The game only came out days ago, so the biggest secrets almost certainly haven't been found yet. Expect a part two.

beats.caption: And if Rockstar's history is any guide, some of the best ones will take months or even years to surface. People were still finding new Vice City secrets long after 2002.
beats.tts: And if Rockstar's history is any guide, some of the best ones will take months or even years to surface. People were still finding new Vice City secrets long after 2002.

beats.caption: Quick recap of the confirmed ones: the tower egg, the Vercetti Estate revolvers, the Ocean View Hotel, Flash FM, Raining Blood on The Chamber, Lucia's Liberty City past, and the six-star wanted level.
beats.tts: Quick recap of the confirmed ones: the tower egg, the Vercetti Estate revolvers, the Ocean View Hotel, Flash FM, Raining Blood on The Chamber, Lucia's Liberty City past, and the six-star wanted level.
